card.name: Subject after a noun starting a relative clause
card.fires_on: The first word of a relative clause right after a noun like things, something, mistakes or medications, such as people, many, all, each or a. The relative word that is normally there (that, which) is left out.

modes.label: People after thing/something
modes.description: The word people or many follows things or something and starts an unmarked relative clause.

modes.label: Other subject words
modes.description: Words like all, each, a or your start the clause after a noun, with no that or which.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a subject like people or many begins a clause that modifies the noun just before it, with no word like that in between.
